content.comment_body: Here's an update: I located an old wireless router, connected it to my laptop via ethernet, and also linked the PLC to the same network. This setup assigned an IP address to my laptop, allowing [product_name] software to detect both the ethernet adapter and controllers. I was able to find and connect to the two controllers. However, the program on the PLC was secured with a password by its author, which I do not have. Is there any way to bypass the password and obtain the programs? Thanks.
I am not aware of any available method to bypass the password.

analysis.insight_summary: The user managed to set up a network link between their laptop and PLC using a wireless router, making it possible to recognize and connect to controllers via [product_name] software. The main obstacle is that the program is password-protected, and neither user has suggested a solution to access the program without the password.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking a way to access and retrieve the program from the PLC even though it is protected by a password.
